per_question.question: When can employees start using their annual leave after being hired?

per_question.question: How much vacation time do employees earn based on years of service?
per_question.answer:
Years of Service | Vacation Time Earned
Less than 2 years | 1.5 pro-rated days per month
Years 2 – 6 | 1.75 pro-rated days per month
7 or more years of service | 2 pro-rated days per month
per_question.ground_truth: Employees earn 1.5 pro-rated days per month for less than 2 years of service, 1.75 pro-rated days per month for years 2 through 6, and 2 pro-rated days per month for 7 or more years of service.

per_question.question: What happens to unused vacation time when an employee is terminated?
per_question.answer: Any earned, but unused vacation will be paid at the time of termination. This payment will be made in a lump sum. Vacation may not be used to extend the termination date.
per_question.ground_truth: Any earned but unused vacation will be paid at the time of termination.

per_question.question: Which employees are eligible for paid holidays?
per_question.answer: Regular full-time and regular part-time employees of the Tri-County Community Action Program, Inc. are eligible for paid holidays. However, Head Start Academic employees follow a different holiday schedule and are not eligible for the same paid holidays as regular employees. Additionally, employees on a paid approved leave of absence are eligible for holiday pay, but those on an unpaid leave are not.
per_question.ground_truth: Regular full-time and regular part-time employees are eligible for paid holidays.

per_question.question: If a paid holiday falls during an employee's scheduled vacation, what happens to their vacation day?
per_question.answer: If a paid holiday falls during an employee’s scheduled vacation period, the employee will receive holiday pay and still retain their vacation day to use at another time.
per_question.ground_truth: If a paid holiday falls during an employee's scheduled vacation period, holiday pay will be provided and the employee will still have a vacation day to use.

per_question.question: What is the organization's policy on outside employment?
per_question.answer: Tri-County Community Action Program, Inc.'s policy on outside employment ensures that it does not interfere with an employee's performance or ability to meet job requirements at the organization. Employees may hold outside employment as long as they can satisfactorily meet their responsibilities with Tri-County Community Action Program, Inc. When providing consultation or training to other organizations on their own time, employees must ensure that the service is rendered entirely outside of their working hours. The use of office equipment, supplies, and personnel from Tri-County Community Action Program, Inc. for such services is prohibited. Additionally, employees are not allowed to work for another employer while on a leave of absence, except for annual leave, or while absent due to illness.
per_question.ground_truth: Employees may hold outside employment as long as it does not interfere with performance or ability to meet the job requirements at the organization.
